facts.label: Retirar um pedido
facts.sub: Diga I am here to pick up an order. Responda What is the name? com Nora, N, O, R, A. Confira com Is the order number thirty-two? Pague com Here is a twenty e Keep the change.

facts.label: Para viagem
facts.sub: Takeout é comida pedida para levar. Você pede por telefone, aplicativo ou no balcão, e retira embalada em caixas ou sacolas de papel.

facts.label: Nome e número
facts.sub: Na retirada, diga o seu nome ou o número do pedido. O atendente confere o pedido e entrega a comida, geralmente com guardanapos e talheres descartáveis.

pages.title: Order thirty-two · 1/3
paragraphs: It is six o’clock on a Thursday evening in Portland. Nora makes a phone order for dinner. Twenty minutes later, she walks into the pizza shop. The room smells like cheese and warm bread. Eli, the clerk, stands behind the counter with boxes. He sees her and smiles.
“Hi! Can I help you?” says Eli. “Yes, I am here to pick up an order.” says Nora. “What is the name?” says Eli.

paragraphs: “Here is a twenty. Please keep the change, and can I get a bag for the pizza box?” says Nora. “Sure. Have a great evening!” says Eli. Eli opens the box to show the pizza. Nora checks the salad and the napkins. Everything is correct, and she pays. Eli puts the pizza box in a paper bag. Nora carries the warm bag home. A phone order saves time on a busy night.
